_comment: Integration-branch only (stablyai/orca-private cloud/integration). Public dev endpoints baked into packaged builds; no secrets. ORCA_BUILD_BILLING_API_URL / ORCA_BUILD_CLOUD_SANDBOX_URL at build time, or ORCA_BILLING_API_URL / ORCA_CLOUD_SANDBOX_URL at run time, override them. allowDevSigning lets this packaged build honor ORCA_CLOUD_SANDBOX_DEV_KEY_FILE (dev operator key) until login.onorca.dev ships the sandbox-token endpoint; the key itself is never in git. Optional build-time service URL defaults (authApiUrl, relayDirectorUrl, pushGatewayUrl, connectorUrl, artifactsApiUrl; or ORCA_BUILD_CLOUD_API_URL / ORCA_BUILD_RELAY_URL / ORCA_BUILD_PUSH_GATEWAY_URL / ORCA_BUILD_CONNECTOR_URL / ORCA_BUILD_ARTIFACTS_API_URL at build time) must be https origins; unset keys keep the built-in defaults.
